access_scope.profile_code_data_path_audit: Only code/configuration and existing throughput-count report are opened; tensor inputs are generated by a seeded CPU torch.Generator. No dataset, feature-cache or checkpoint loader exists in this namespace.

measurement_contract.memory_scope: Validation keeps optimizer state and previous allocator caches resident; explicitly training-process capacity, not standalone inference peak. CPU RSS includes process/imports.
measurement_contract.synchronization: CUDA before and after each timed step

model_contract.action_embedding: Official kernel-one Conv1d35to10; action channels concatenated per patch, predicted action channels discarded.
model_contract.causality: Frame-block mask and rolling three-action window; synthetic gradients confirm later actions/observations cannot affect earlier forecasts.
model_contract.input_sequence: Three observed384x4x4grids, two past35Dblocks and tenfuture35Dblocks; each block represents five consecutive7Dcommands.
model_contract.normalization: Shared per-channel normalization contract retained; profile uses synthetic zero/unit statistics only.
model_contract.proprioception: Absent; no dummy supervised state or privileged data.

matched_recursive_h10.bptt: Earlier predicted features remain in later loss graph; synthetic retained-gradient test passes.
matched_recursive_h10.interpretation: Deliberate matched-loss alternative, not official training-objective reproduction.

official_one_step_shifted.interpretation: All three shifted visual slots as in official VWorldModel.forward, after explicitly documented input/coordinate adaptation. No action or proprio loss.

projection_scope.limits: Synthetic predictor-only extrapolation excludes encoder, IO/transfers, checkpoints, final evaluation, queue and contention. Native objective is not projected over its potentially larger shorter-window population.

scientific_limits: Resource feasibility only; no numerical synthetic loss is published as benchmark accuracy.
Adapter is not unchanged official DINO-WM benchmark reproduction: tokenization, normalization, proprioception, action schema and matched training budget differ explicitly.
No objective selection based on existing reserved outcomes; future reserved evaluation would be a posthoc external comparison.
Actual GPU timing/memory and OOM feasibility remain unmeasured until the reviewed job runs.
scope: Pre-submission source and CPU synthetic contract review only. Clears the registered one-GPU synthetic capacity profile; no benchmark training, dataset access or accuracy evaluation is authorized or performed by this receipt.

tests.initial_issue_resolved: profile.py shadowed the Python stdlib profile module; renamed profile_cuda.py and reran all contracts.
